     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0EndgameContract
     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOnePresentation
     8	import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Subfunctor.Image
     9	
    10	/-!
    11	# The presentation locus for the rank-one Abel map
    12	
    13	`PicRankOneOpen` is the functorial locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer whose pullback to
    14	every affine test admits a tied `PicRankOneLocalPresentation`.  Quantifying after every affine
    15	pullback makes the condition intrinsic on arbitrary test schemes; stability under further
    16	pullback is exactly `picEtMap_comp`.
    17	
    18	The remaining declarations form the corresponding preimages in the widened divisor functor and
    19	in its canonical representing Yoneda functor, together with the restricted Abel transformations.
    20	These are logical subfunctors only.  In particular, this file does not assert that
    21	`PicRankOneOpen` is represented by an open subscheme.  The relative-openness acceptance gate and
    22	the conditional universal-divisor carrier contract are exposed separately in `DivRankOneOpen.lean`.
    23	-/
    24	
    25	set_option autoImplicit false
    26	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    27	
    28	universe u
    29	
    30	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
    31	
    32	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    33	
    34	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    35	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    36	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    37	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    38	
    39	noncomputable section
    40	
    41	/-- The rank-one presentation locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer.
    42	
    43	Membership means that every affine pullback of the input plus class admits a local presentation
    44	tied to that pullback.  This is the correct logical subfunctor underlying the future open Picard
    45	locus; no openness or representability assertion is part of this definition. -/
    46	def PicRankOneOpen :
    47	    Subfunctor (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) where
    48	  obj T := {lam | ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    49	      (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    50	    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    51	      ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))}
    52	  map {T T'} f lam hlam A _ _ t := by
    53	    let F := picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)
    54	    have e : F.map t.op (F.map f lam) = F.map (t ≫ f.unop).op lam := by
    55	      apply Subtype.ext
    56	      exact (picEtMap_comp C f.unop t lam.1).symm
    57	    rw [e]
    58	    exact hlam A (t ≫ f.unop)

   107	/-- The inclusion of the public rank-one locus into its degree-genus ambient functor. -/

   109	    (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor ⟶ picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ) :=

   112	/-- The same inclusion after the slice-to-big-site `Σ` extension.
   113	
   114	`IsOpenImmersion.presheaf` is a property of presheaves on schemes.  The rank-one functor is

   117	def picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl :

   122	/-- Relative openness of the public locus, in Mathlib's presheaf sense.

   130	/-! ## The explicit fibre producer contract -/
   131	
   132	/-- A fibre of the rank-one locus over one test class, presented by an open of that test.
   133	
   134	The `exists_factor` field is tied to the displayed class `g` and to an arbitrary source value `v`.
   135	It is the family-level content needed for relative representability; the open immersion itself
   136	supplies uniqueness of the factor.  Thus this structure cannot be inhabited by an unrelated open
   137	or by a fieldwise dimension statement. -/
   138	structure PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented
   139	    {X : Scheme.{u}}
   140	    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
   141	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))) where
   142	  W : X.Opens
   143	  fst : yoneda.obj (W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶
   144	    Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor
   145	  sq : fst ≫ picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi = yoneda.map W.ι ≫ g
   146	  exists_factor : ∀ (S : Scheme.{u})
   147	    (v : (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor).obj (Opposite.op S))
   148	    (w : S ⟶ X),
   149	    (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (Opposite.op S) v =
   150	      g.app (Opposite.op S) w →
   151	    ∃ u : S ⟶ (W : Scheme.{u}),
   152	      fst.app (Opposite.op S) u = v ∧ u ≫ W.ι = w
   153	
   154	namespace PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented
   155	
   156	variable {X : Scheme.{u}}
   157	variable {g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
   158	  Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))}

   160	/-- The fibre square supplied by `FibrePresented` is a pullback of presheaves. -/
   161	theorem isPullback (D : PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented pi g) :
   162	    IsPullback D.fst (yoneda.map D.W.ι) (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi) g := by
   163	  refine IsPullback.of_forall_isPullback_app fun S => ?_
   164	  rw [Types.isPullback_iff]
   165	  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
   166	  · exact congrArg (fun φ : yoneda.obj (D.W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶
   167	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) =>
   168	      φ.app S) D.sq
   169	  · rintro u₁ u₂ ⟨-, h₂⟩
   170	    exact (cancel_mono D.W.ι).mp h₂
   171	  · intro v w hvw
   172	    obtain ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩ := D.exists_factor S.unop v w hvw
   173	    exact ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩

   177	/-- An arbitrary-test fibre producer discharges the relative openness gate. -/
   178	theorem picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_fibrePresented

   185	  intro X g

   199	    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶

    10	/-!
    11	# The big-site Zariski sheaf `pic⁰` and the 01JJ seam (DAT-6, stage 3)
    12	
    13	The slice trick assembled: the Σ-extension of the degree-zero Picard functor is an
    14	honest sheaf for the big Zariski topology on `Scheme`, and mathlib's 01JJ
    15	local-representability engine applied to it descends to a representation of the
    16	degree-zero Picard functor itself on the slice.
    17	
    18	* `AlgebraicGeometry.pic0TypeFunctor C`: the degree-zero Picard functor with values in
    19	  types — the `forget₂ ⋙ forget` massage of `pic0Functor`, owned here once
    20	  (`pic0TypeFunctor_obj`/`pic0TypeFunctor_map_apply` are `rfl`).
    21	* `AlgebraicGeometry.pic0SigmaFunctor C : Scheme.{u}ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u`: the Σ-extension
    22	  `T ↦ Σ (a : T ⟶ Spec k), pic⁰(Over.mk a)` — the big-site carrier.
    23	* `AlgebraicGeometry.pic0SigmaFunctor_isSheaf` / **`pic0SigmaSheaf C`**: the sheaf
    24	  certificate.  By mathlib's own reduction the big-site sheaf condition collapses to
    25	  elementwise ∃!-amalgamation on honest open covers
    26	  (`Precoverage.isSheaf_toGrothendieck_iff_of_isStableUnderBaseChange`,
    27	  `exists_cover_of_mem_pretopology`, `Presieve.isSheafFor_arrows_iff` — the
    28	  `BigZariski` TODO is never touched): the Σ-components glue by
    29	  `Scheme.Cover.glueMorphisms`, the fibre components glue by the DAT-6 stage-1
    30	  evaluation bridge (`pic0Subgroup_existsUnique_of_cover`), and the two layers are
    31	  stitched by the stage-2 amalgamation seam (`sigmaExtension_map_mk_eq_iff`) and
    32	  compatibility descent (`map_eq_of_sigmaExtension_map_eq`).
    33	* `AlgebraicGeometry.pic0RepresentableByOfCharts`: **the DAT-glue seam** — given a
    34	  chart family of relatively representable open immersions into `pic0SigmaSheaf`
    35	  (DAT-C) that is jointly locally surjective (DAT-B), mathlib's
    36	  `Scheme.LocalRepresentability.representableBy` produces a representation of the
    37	  Σ-extension by the glued scheme, and the stage-2 Σ-descent `overSlice` turns it
    38	  into a representation of `pic0TypeFunctor C` by the glued scheme over the
    39	  Σ-component of the universal element.
    40	-/
    41	
    42	set_option autoImplicit false
    43	
    44	universe u
    45	
    46	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
    47	
    48	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    49	
    50	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    51	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    52	variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    53	
    54	/-! ## The type-valued degree-zero Picard functor -/
    55	
    56	/-- The degree-zero Picard functor with values in types: the `forget₂ ⋙ forget`
    57	massage of `pic0Functor`, owned here once for the Σ-extension statements. -/
    58	noncomputable abbrev pic0TypeFunctor : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u :=
    59	  (pic0Functor C ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat) ⋙ forget GrpCat
    60	
    61	@[simp]
    62	lemma pic0TypeFunctor_obj (T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ) :
    63	    (pic0TypeFunctor C).obj T = pic0Subgroup C T.unop :=
    64	  rfl

    66	lemma pic0TypeFunctor_map_apply {T T' : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ} (g : T ⟶ T')
    67	    (lam : pic0Subgroup C T.unop) :
    68	    (pic0TypeFunctor C).map g lam = pic0Map C g.unop lam :=
    69	  rfl
    70	
    71	/-! ## The Σ-extension as a presheaf on the big site -/
    72	
    73	/-- **The big-site carrier of the slice trick**: the Σ-extension of the type-valued
    74	degree-zero Picard functor, `T ↦ Σ (a : T ⟶ Spec k), pic⁰(Over.mk a)`.  Reducible so
    75	that the stage-2 `sigmaExtension` calculus applies syntactically. -/
    76	noncomputable abbrev pic0SigmaFunctor : Scheme.{u}ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u :=
    77	  Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (pic0TypeFunctor C)
    78	
    79	variable [GeometricallyReduced C.hom]
    80	
    81	set_option maxHeartbeats 800000 in
    82	-- The amalgamation seams unify the `forget₂ ⋙ forget` massage of `pic0Functor`
    83	-- against the Σ-extension calculus by unfolding; within the DAT-2/PicEtMap 1600000
    84	-- precedent.
    85	/-- **The big-site Zariski sheaf certificate of the Σ-extension** (DAT-6 keystone,
    86	worksheet §1.2 site gap 1): mathlib's reduction collapses the sheaf condition to
    87	elementwise ∃!-amalgamation on honest open covers, where the Σ-components glue by
    88	`Scheme.Cover.glueMorphisms` and the fibre components by the stage-1 evaluation
    89	bridge. -/
    90	theorem pic0SigmaFunctor_isSheaf :
    91	    Presieve.IsSheaf Scheme.zariskiTopology (pic0SigmaFunctor C) := by
    92	  rw [Precoverage.isSheaf_toGrothendieck_iff_of_isStableUnderBaseChange]
    93	  intro Y S hS
    94	  obtain ⟨𝓤, rfl⟩ := Scheme.exists_cover_of_mem_pretopology hS
    95	  rw [Presieve.isSheafFor_arrows_iff]
    96	  intro x hx
    97	  -- glue the Σ-components along the scheme-level cover
    98	  have hpair : ∀ i j, pullback.fst (𝓤.f i) (𝓤.f j) ≫ (x i).1
    99	      = pullback.snd (𝓤.f i) (𝓤.f j) ≫ (x j).1 := fun i j =>
   100	    congrArg Sigma.fst
   101	      (hx i j (pullback (𝓤.f i) (𝓤.f j)) (pullback.fst _ _) (pullback.snd _ _)
   102	        pullback.condition)
   103	  obtain ⟨aY, ha⟩ : ∃ aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k), ∀ i, 𝓤.f i ≫ aY = (x i).1 :=
   104	    ⟨𝓤.glueMorphisms (fun i => (x i).1) hpair,
   105	      fun i => 𝓤.ι_glueMorphisms (fun i => (x i).1) hpair i⟩
   106	  -- the induced slice cover of `Over.mk aY` and its member sections
   107	  haveI hop : ∀ i, IsOpenImmersion
   108	      ((Over.homMk (𝓤.f i) (ha i) : Over.mk ((x i).1) ⟶ Over.mk aY)).left :=
   109	    fun i => 𝓤.map_prop i
   110	  have hcov : ∀ p : (Over.mk aY).left, ∃ i, p ∈ Scheme.Hom.opensRange
   111	      ((Over.homMk (𝓤.f i) (ha i) : Over.mk ((x i).1) ⟶ Over.mk aY)).left := by
   112	    intro p
   113	    obtain ⟨i, y, hy⟩ := 𝓤.exists_eq p
   114	    exact ⟨i, y, hy⟩
   115	  -- the fibre components are a compatible family on the slice cover
   116	  have hcompat : ∀ (i j : 𝓤.I₀) (Z : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   117	      (gi : Z ⟶ Over.mk ((x i).1)) (gj : Z ⟶ Over.mk ((x j).1)),
   118	      gi ≫ (Over.homMk (𝓤.f i) (ha i) : Over.mk ((x i).1) ⟶ Over.mk aY)
   119	          = gj ≫ (Over.homMk (𝓤.f j) (ha j) : Over.mk ((x j).1) ⟶ Over.mk aY) →
   120	      pic0Map C gi ((x i).2) = pic0Map C gj ((x j).2) := by
   121	    intro i j Z gi gj hg
   122	    have hleft : gi.left ≫ 𝓤.f i = gj.left ≫ 𝓤.f j := congrArg Over.Hom.left hg
   123	    have hdesc := Over.map_eq_of_sigmaExtension_map_eq gi gj
   124	      (hx i j Z.left gi.left gj.left hleft)
   125	    rwa [pic0TypeFunctor_map_apply, pic0TypeFunctor_map_apply] at hdesc
   126	  -- glue the fibre components by the stage-1 evaluation bridge
   127	  obtain ⟨s, hs, hsu⟩ := pic0Subgroup_existsUnique_of_cover
   128	    (fun i => (Over.homMk (𝓤.f i) (ha i) : Over.mk ((x i).1) ⟶ Over.mk aY))
   129	    hcov (fun i => (x i).2) hcompat
   130	  refine ⟨⟨aY, s⟩, fun i => ?_, ?_⟩
   131	  · -- the glued Σ-element restricts to the members
   132	    refine (Over.sigmaExtension_map_mk_eq_iff (𝓤.f i) (ha i) s ((x i).2)).mpr ?_
   133	    rw [pic0TypeFunctor_map_apply]
   134	    exact hs i
   135	  · -- uniqueness: Σ-components by `hom_ext`, fibres by bridge separation
   136	    rintro ⟨a', s'⟩ ht'
   137	    obtain rfl : aY = a' := 𝓤.hom_ext aY a' fun i =>
   138	      (ha i).trans (congrArg Sigma.fst (ht' i) : 𝓤.f i ≫ a' = (x i).1).symm
   139	    refine congrArg (Sigma.mk aY) (hsu s' fun i => ?_)
   140	    have hmem := (Over.sigmaExtension_map_mk_eq_iff (𝓤.f i) (ha i) s' ((x i).2)).mp
   141	      (ht' i)
   142	    rwa [pic0TypeFunctor_map_apply] at hmem
   143	
   144	/-- **The Σ-extension of the degree-zero Picard functor, bundled as a sheaf on the
   145	big Zariski site** — the object mathlib's 01JJ local-representability engine
   146	consumes. -/
   147	noncomputable def pic0SigmaSheaf : Sheaf Scheme.zariskiTopology.{u} (Type u) :=
   148	  ⟨pic0SigmaFunctor C,
   149	    (isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_of_type _ _).mpr (pic0SigmaFunctor_isSheaf C)⟩
   150	
   151	/-! ## The DAT-glue seam -/
   152	
   153	/-- **The DAT-glue statement (worksheet §4, DAT-glue row)**: a chart family of
   154	relatively representable open immersions into the Σ-extension sheaf (DAT-C's
   155	certificates) that is jointly Zariski-locally surjective (DAT-B's coverage) induces —
   156	through mathlib's 01JJ engine and the stage-2 Σ-descent — a representation of the
   157	type-valued degree-zero Picard functor by the glued scheme placed over the
   158	Σ-component of the universal element.  The represented object's `.left` is
   159	`(Scheme.LocalRepresentability.glueData hf).glued` and its `.hom` is the universal
   160	element's Σ-component, both definitionally. -/
   161	noncomputable def pic0RepresentableByOfCharts
   162	    {ι : Type u} {X : ι → Scheme.{u}}
   163	    (f : ∀ i, yoneda.obj (X i) ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1)
   164	    (hf : ∀ i, IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (f i))
   165	    [Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.zariskiTopology (Sigma.desc f)] :

    10	/-!
    11	# The widened divisor representer at the Picard atlas seam
    12	
    13	The widened divisor functor of a challenge curve is represented at the genus parameter.  This
    14	module inserts that representation into the Abel construction and then into the Zariski-local
    15	representability theorem for the degree-zero Picard functor.
    16	
    17	The resulting chart family has no assumed divisor representation.  Its remaining inputs are the
    18	two geometric conditions of the local-representability theorem: every restricted Abel map is a
    19	representable open immersion, and the restricted maps cover the Picard sheaf pointwise.
    20	
    21	This is not an unconditional Picard representability result: the final declaration below retains
    22	both geometric inputs.  Moreover, at the larger admissible coverage parameter the raw Abel map has
    23	positive-dimensional linear-system fibres in positive genus, so the larger divisor representer
    24	cannot simply be substituted as an open chart source.  The remaining datum-tail construction is
    25	the corrected Altman--Kleiman step: represent the quotient by equality of the induced Picard class,
    26	thereby removing those fibres before applying the Picard representability seam.
    27	
    28	## Main declarations
    29	
    30	* `AlgebraicGeometry.abelSigmaChartAffGenus` is the widened Abel chart formed from the chosen
    31	  genus-parameter divisor representer.
    32	* `AlgebraicGeometry.universalDivFamAffGenus` is its universal widened divisor family.
    33	* `AlgebraicGeometry.abelSigmaChartAffAdmissible` is the no-argument widened Abel map at the
    34	  unconditional admissible coverage parameter; its legal chart index is chosen internally.
    35	* `AlgebraicGeometry.universalDivFamAffAdmissible` is the corresponding universal family.
    36	* `AlgebraicGeometry.affineGenusChart` restricts a multi-index family of these maps to chosen
    37	  source opens.
    38	* `AlgebraicGeometry.pic0RepresentableByOfAffineGenusCharts` is the conditional final assembly
    39	  once the restricted charts are open immersions and cover pointwise.
    40	-/
    41	
    42	set_option autoImplicit false
    43	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    44	
    45	universe u
    46	
    47	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory Opposite
    48	
    49	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    50	
    51	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    52	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    53	variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    54	
    55	noncomputable section
    56	
    57	/-- The universal widened divisor family carried by the chosen genus-parameter representer. -/
    58	def universalDivFamAffGenus :
    59	    divFamZarAff C (genus C) (divRepAffGenusScheme C) :=
    60	  (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv (𝟙 _)
    61	
    62	/-- Pulling back the chosen universal family gives the widened family classified by the
    63	corresponding morphism into the genus representer. -/
    64	theorem universalDivFamAffGenus_map {T : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    65	    (q : T ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C) :
    66	    divFamZarAff.map C (genus C) q (universalDivFamAffGenus C)
    67	      = (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q := by
    68	  have h := (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv_comp q
    69	    (𝟙 (divRepAffGenusScheme C))
    70	  rw [Category.comp_id] at h
    71	  exact h.symm
    72	
    73	/-- The universal widened divisor family carried by the unconditional representer at the
    74	admissible coverage parameter. -/
    75	def universalDivFamAffAdmissible :
    76	    divFamZarAff C (divRepAffAdmissibleParameter C) (divRepAffAdmissibleScheme C) :=
    77	  (divFunctorAff_admissible_representableBy C).homEquiv (𝟙 _)
    78	
    79	/-- Pullback of the admissible universal family agrees with classification by the unconditional
    80	admissible representer. -/
    81	theorem universalDivFamAffAdmissible_map {T : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    82	    (q : T ⟶ divRepAffAdmissibleScheme C) :
    83	    divFamZarAff.map C (divRepAffAdmissibleParameter C) q
    84	        (universalDivFamAffAdmissible C)
    85	      = (divFunctorAff_admissible_representableBy C).homEquiv q := by
    86	  have h := (divFunctorAff_admissible_representableBy C).homEquiv_comp q
    87	    (𝟙 (divRepAffAdmissibleScheme C))
    88	  rw [Category.comp_id] at h
    89	  exact h.symm
    90	
    91	/-- The widened Abel chart at the genus parameter, using the challenge curve's chosen divisor
    92	representer rather than accepting a representability witness as an argument. -/
    93	def abelSigmaChartAffGenus
    94	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
    95	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
    96	      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (genus C : ℤ)) :
    97	    yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1 :=
    98	  abelSigmaChartAff C (genus C) (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C) m Z hdeg
    99

   106	    yoneda.obj (divRepAffAdmissibleScheme C).left ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1 := by
   107	  classical
   108	  letI : C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := .ofHom C.hom

   110	    inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
   111	  haveI : IsIntegral C.left := isIntegral_left_of_geometricallyReduced C

   117	    moduleFinite_hModule_zero C
   118	  haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1) :=
   119	    moduleFinite_hModule_one C
   120	  let hchart := exists_uniform_admissibleCoverageChart_eq_univ
   121	    (C := C) (divRepAffP1Map_comp C) (genus C) (chi_moduleKSheaf C)
   122	  let m : ℕ := Classical.choose hchart
   123	  let hZ := Classical.choose_spec hchart
   124	  let Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor := Classical.choose hZ
   125	  have hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
   126	      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C)
   127	        - (divRepAffAdmissibleParameter C : ℤ) := by
   128	    change Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
   129	      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C)
   130	        - (admissibleCoverageParameter
   131	            (C := C) (divRepAffP1Map_comp C) (genus C) : ℤ)
   132	    exact (Classical.choose_spec hZ).1
   133	  exact abelSigmaChartAff C (divRepAffAdmissibleParameter C)
   134	    (divFunctorAff_admissible_representableBy C) m Z hdeg

   136	/-- The structure morphism read from a genus-parameter widened Abel chart is the structure
   137	morphism of the chosen divisor representer. -/
   138	lemma chartHom_abelSigmaChartAffGenus
   139	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
   140	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
   141	      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (genus C : ℤ))
   142	    {ι : Type u} (i : ι) :
   143	    chartHom C (fun _ : ι => abelSigmaChartAffGenus C m Z hdeg) i
   144	      = (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom :=
   145	  chartHom_abelSigmaChartAff (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C) m Z hdeg i
   146	
   147	/-- The structure morphism read from the admissible Abel map is the structure morphism of the
   148	unconditional admissible divisor representer. -/
   149	lemma chartHom_abelSigmaChartAffAdmissible {ι : Type u} (i : ι) :
   150	    chartHom C (fun _ : ι => abelSigmaChartAffAdmissible C) i
   151	      = (divRepAffAdmissibleScheme C).hom := by
   152	  dsimp only [abelSigmaChartAffAdmissible]
   153	  exact chartHom_abelSigmaChartAff
   154	    (divFunctorAff_admissible_representableBy C) _ _ _ i
   155	
   156	/-- A multi-index family of genus-parameter widened Abel charts, restricted to source opens.
   157	Different indices may use different twists and different opens, but they all use the same
   158	unconditional divisor representer. -/
   159	def affineGenusChart {ι : Type u}
   160	    (m : ι → ℕ) (Z : ι → (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
   161	    (hdeg : ∀ i, Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k (Z i)
   162	      = (m i : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (genus C : ℤ))
   163	    (V : ∀ _ : ι, (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left.Opens) (i : ι) :
   164	    yoneda.obj (V i : Scheme) ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1 :=
   165	  restrictChart (abelSigmaChartAffGenus C (m i) (Z i) (hdeg i)) (V i)
   166	
   167	/-- The structure morphism of a restricted genus chart is the inclusion of its source open
   168	followed by the structure morphism of the chosen divisor representer. -/
   169	lemma chartHom_affineGenusChart {ι : Type u}
   170	    (m : ι → ℕ) (Z : ι → (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
   171	    (hdeg : ∀ i, Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k (Z i)
   172	      = (m i : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (genus C : ℤ))
   173	    (V : ∀ _ : ι, (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left.Opens) (i : ι) :
   174	    chartHom C (affineGenusChart C m Z hdeg V) i
   175	      = (V i).ι ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom := by
   176	  have hrestrict := chartHom_restrictChart (C := C)
   177	    (abelSigmaChartAffGenus C (m i) (Z i) (hdeg i)) (V i) i
   178	  have hgenus := chartHom_abelSigmaChartAffGenus C (m i) (Z i) (hdeg i) i
   179	  simpa only [chartHom, affineGenusChart] using
   180	    hrestrict.trans (congrArg ((V i).ι ≫ ·) hgenus)
   181	
   182	/-- The degree-zero Picard functor is represented by the glued object of any pointwise-covering
   183	family of open genus-parameter widened Abel charts.
   184	
   185	The divisor representation is construction data, not a hypothesis: it is supplied by
   186	`divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy`.  The two hypotheses are exactly the geometric inputs of
   187	Zariski local representability. -/
   188	def pic0RepresentableByOfAffineGenusCharts {ι : Type u}
   189	    (m : ι → ℕ) (Z : ι → (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
   190	    (hdeg : ∀ i, Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k (Z i)
   191	      = (m i : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (genus C : ℤ))
   192	    (V : ∀ _ : ι, (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left.Opens)
   193	    (hf : ∀ i, IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (affineGenusChart C m Z hdeg V i))
   194	    (hcov : PointwiseCoverage C (affineGenusChart C m Z hdeg V)) :
   195	    Σ J : Over (Spec (.of k)), (pic0TypeFunctor C).RepresentableBy J := by
   196	  letI : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.zariskiTopology
   197	      (Sigma.desc (affineGenusChart C m Z hdeg V)) :=
   198	    isLocallySurjective_sigmaDesc_of_pointwise C _ hcov
   199	  exact ⟨_, pic0RepresentableByOfCharts C (affineGenusChart C m Z hdeg V) hf⟩
   200

name: project-git
description: How git works in an Archon Horizon workspace — one out-of-tree workspace ledger (no per-project repos); read a project's history by pathspec or by a session's commit trailers.
---

Read this before running `git diff`/`git log` on a project.

## The model

- **One out-of-tree workspace ledger.** Archon commits to a single repo whose git
  dir is `.archon-horizon/vcs/workspace.git` with the workspace **root** as its
  work tree (driven via `--git-dir`/`--work-tree`). `<root>/.git` is deliberately
  untouched — it is reserved for a user repo. The ledger records one commit per
  completed session: `config.yaml`, the session's scoped project files, and
  `.archon-horizon/` shared state; never the binary git dirs under
  `.archon-horizon/vcs/`, locks, or other volatile internals.
- **There are no per-project repositories.** A project directory has no nested
  `.git/`, and there is no `.archon-horizon/vcs/<project>.git`. A project's
  "history" is simply the workspace ledger filtered to that project's path.
- **You record your own work by committing to the ledger** with plain `git` (see
  below). Commit after each independently useful, verified proof/file/tooling
  change, before a long build or delegated review, and before expanding scope.
  A multi-hour implementation session should normally have several commits; one
  commit is appropriate only when the work is genuinely atomic. The message +
  diff is how progress is read, so use a semantic, math-first subject. Provenance
  trailers are added automatically; do not write them.

So a plain `git diff` at the root sees only a user repo (if any), never Archon's.
Drive the out-of-tree workspace ledger explicitly (or use `hgit`).

## Recording your work (committing)

Commits go to the ledger, **not** to `<root>/.git` and **not** via any project
`.git` (there is none). Do **not** `export GIT_DIR` / `GIT_WORK_TREE` yourself — that
would redirect `lake` and other tooling. Two equivalent ways to commit:

```bash
# 1) The `hgit` wrapper (on the session env as $HORIZON_GIT) — plain git, ledger-scoped:
"$HORIZON_GIT" add path/to/File.lean
"$HORIZON_GIT" commit -m "feat(chapter): prove foo_lemma" \
  --trailer 'Summary=**Proof.** Closed the compactness step using $K \subseteq X$.'

# 2) The explicit form (identical effect):
git --git-dir="$HORIZON_LEDGER_GIT_DIR" --work-tree="$HORIZON_LEDGER_WORK_TREE" \
    add path/to/File.lean
git --git-dir="$HORIZON_LEDGER_GIT_DIR" --work-tree="$HORIZON_LEDGER_WORK_TREE" \
    commit -m "feat(chapter): prove foo_lemma" \
    --trailer 'Summary=**Proof.** Closed the compactness step using $K \subseteq X$.'
```

Ordinary git: the ledger's index tracks HEAD, so `add` then `commit` records your
files on top of it. Horizon's own commits stage in a private index and never leave
anything staged in your way.

- **Prefer the pathspec commit** — name the paths on the commit itself:
  `"$HORIZON_GIT" commit -m "…" --trailer 'Summary=…' -- path/to/File.lean`
  It records exactly those files, ignores whatever else may be staged, and git
  builds its tree from the **current** HEAD — so it cannot silently revert a
  concurrent session's files the way a commit built on a stale index can.
- Add at least one **`Summary` trailer** explaining the important change, not
  merely repeating the subject. Use one trailer per distinct explanation when
  useful. Its value supports Markdown and LaTeX, so concise mathematical context
  such as `--trailer 'Summary=**Invariant.** Preserves $f(x)=x$ on $A$.'` renders
  directly in the dashboard commit item. Keep each trailer on one line; repeat
  `--trailer 'Summary=…'` for a few separate points.
- Do not wait for the whole task to be complete. A checkpoint commit must build
  or otherwise be internally coherent, but it may explicitly leave the next
  named obligation open.
- Stage **explicit paths** you changed rather than `add -A` — the work tree is the
  whole workspace, so `-A` can sweep in unrelated files.
- `Archon-Run`/`Session`/`Role`/`Task`/`Projects` trailers are stamped for you by a
  hook from the session env; your message stays clean.
- Build artifacts (`.lake`, `*.olean`, …) are excluded automatically, and any
  high-confidence credential is **redacted to `XXXX`** in the staged content (not
  blocked), so a broad add still won't leak a secret into the ledger.
- If the guard reports *"redacted possible secret(s) to XXXX"*, it scrubbed a
  matched credential and let the commit through — **rotate the real credential**,
  and check you didn't stage more than you meant to (`ARCHON_HORIZON_ALLOW_SECRETS=1`
  skips the scan entirely). A *separate* guard still **blocks** a commit that would
  silently delete tracked files you didn't change (a stale-index clobber); re-seed
  the index (`git read-tree HEAD && git add -- <your files>`) rather than forcing it.

Then verify **in the ledger**, and verify the **paths**, not just the SHA — a bare
`git cat-file` runs against `<root>/.git`, which has not seen your commit yet and will
make a perfectly real SHA look fabricated:

```bash
"$HORIZON_GIT" ls-tree --name-only HEAD -- path/to/File.lean   # empty ⇒ NOT in HEAD
```

## Concurrent sessions and the clobber guard

Several sessions may commit to the ledger at once. A commit whose index was
seeded from an older HEAD (e.g. `read-tree`, then a concurrent session commits,
then you commit) produces a tree that *lacks* the other session's new files —
plain git would commit it without any error and silently delete their work.
The ledger's `pre-commit` guard now rejects any commit that stages deletions
you did not ask for:

- *"this commit would DELETE N tracked file(s) you did not change"* — your
  index base is stale (or you are committing through a polluted shared index).
  **Do not override.** Re-seed and retry; your own edits are safe in the
  working tree, which concurrent commits never touch:

  ```bash
  "$HORIZON_GIT" read-tree HEAD
  "$HORIZON_GIT" add -- <your files>
  "$HORIZON_GIT" commit -m "…"          # or just: commit -m "…" -- <your files>
  ```

- Deleting a file **on purpose** (moved/retired): set
  `ARCHON_HORIZON_ALLOW_DELETIONS=1` for that one commit.

At the **end of the session**, re-verify content — not just that HEAD moved —
since a stale-based commit elsewhere could have landed after yours (the guard
blocks new offenders, but belt-and-braces):

```bash
"$HORIZON_GIT" cat-file -e HEAD:path/to/File.lean && \
"$HORIZON_GIT" show HEAD:path/to/File.lean | diff -q - path/to/File.lean
```

If you were clobbered anyway: `read-tree HEAD`, re-add your files from the
working tree, commit once.

## Reading history / a project's diff

Run from the workspace root:

```bash
GD=.archon-horizon/vcs/workspace.git

git --git-dir=$GD --work-tree=. log  --oneline -n 20                       # whole ledger
git --git-dir=$GD --work-tree=. log  --oneline -n 20 -- <project-path>     # one project
git --git-dir=$GD --work-tree=. diff HEAD~1 -- <project-path>
git --git-dir=$GD --work-tree=. diff HEAD~1 -- '<project-path>/*.lean'
git --git-dir=$GD --work-tree=. show <sha>
```

Each commit carries provenance trailers — `Archon-Run`, `Archon-Session`,
`Archon-Role`, `Archon-Task`, `Archon-Projects` — so you can map a commit to the
run/session that made it and see what it touched without parsing prose:

```bash
git --git-dir=$GD --work-tree=. \
  log --format='%H %(trailers:key=Archon-Session,valueonly)' -- <project-path>
```

To see what the previous Horizon agent changed, find its session's commit(s) by
the `Archon-Session` trailer and diff each against **its own parent** (what that
commit changed).

## Caveats

- With parallel runs the ledger is one shared branch: commits from several runs
  interleave, and a commit's parent may belong to another run or a dashboard
  publish. Diff a commit against its own parent (what *that* commit changed), not
  across a span of sessions — that would fold in unrelated runs' changes.
- The bundled author identity is `Archon Horizon <archon-horizon@local>`.

    82	/-! ## Arbitrary-test uniqueness of the widened Abel map on the rank-one locus -/
    83	
    84	/-- **Arbitrary-test rank-one uniqueness**: two widened vehicle sections over an arbitrary test
    85	`T` whose widened Abel values agree, one of whose Abel classes lies in the rank-one locus, are
    86	equal.  The vehicle is separated by affine opens, and on each affine open the pulled-back rank-one
    87	class feeds the affine `rankOneDivisorUniqueness`. -/
    88	theorem divFamZarAff_eq_of_rankOne (T : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    89	    (s₁ s₂ : divFamZarAff C (genus C) T)
    90	    (hs₁ : (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T) s₁ ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op T))
    91	    (habel : abelDivAff' C (genus C) T s₁ = abelDivAff' C (genus C) T s₂) :
    92	    s₁ = s₂ := by
    93	  refine divFamZarAff.ext fun U => ?_
    94	  -- pull the rank-one class back along the affine-open test object
    95	  have hmem : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map (Over.fromSpecAffine T U).op
    96	        ((abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T) s₁)
    97	      ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op (overSpec k Γ(T.left, U.1))) :=
    98	    picRankOneOpen_map_mem pi (Over.fromSpecAffine T U).op hs₁
    99	  -- the pulled-back Abel value is the affine Abel value of `s₁.1 U`
   100	  have hval : abelDivAffPlus C Γ(T.left, U.1) (s₁.1 U)
   101	      = picEtAffineEquiv C Γ(T.left, U.1)
   102	          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map (Over.fromSpecAffine T U).op
   103	            ((abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T) s₁)).1 := by
   104	    have h1 : ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map (Over.fromSpecAffine T U).op
   105	          ((abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T) s₁)).1
   106	        = picEtMap C (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) (abelDivAff' C (genus C) T s₁) := rfl
   107	    rw [h1, picEtMap_abelDivAff', picEtAffineEquiv_abelDivAff',
   108	      divFamZarAffAffineEquiv_map_fromSpecAffine]
   109	  -- the two affine Abel values agree, from equality of the vehicle Abel values
   110	  have hU := congrArg (fun w : picEt C T => w.1 U) habel
   111	  rw [abelDivAff'_val, abelDivAff'_val] at hU
   112	  exact rankOneDivisorUniqueness pi Γ(T.left, U.1) _ hmem (s₁.1 U) (s₂.1 U) hval
   113	    (hU.symm.trans hval)
   114	
   115	/-! ## Monomorphy of the restricted Abel map -/
   116	
   117	/-- The represented Abel map is injective on every slice object: this is arbitrary-test
   118	uniqueness read through the subfunctor preimage plumbing. -/
   119	theorem rankOneAbelRepresented_app_injective (Z : Over (Spec (.of k))) :
   120	    Function.Injective ((rankOneAbelRepresented pi).app (op Z)) := by
   121	  intro x y h
   122	  have hinj : Function.Injective
   123	      ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom.app (op Z)) :=
   124	    Function.LeftInverse.injective fun a =>
   125	      (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom_inv_id_app_apply (op Z) a
   126	  set sx := (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom.app (op Z) x.val with hsx
   127	  set sy := (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom.app (op Z) y.val with hsy
   128	  -- the underlying widened Abel values agree
   129	  have happ : ∀ w : (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).toFunctor.obj (op Z),
   130	      ((rankOneAbelRepresented pi).app (op Z) w).val
   131	        = (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op Z)
   132	            ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom.app (op Z) w.val) := fun _ => rfl
   133	  have hval : (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op Z) sx
   134	      = (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op Z) sy := by
   135	    have := congrArg Subtype.val h
   136	    rwa [happ, happ] at this
   137	  have habel : abelDivAff' C (genus C) Z sx = abelDivAff' C (genus C) Z sy := by
   138	    have := congrArg Subtype.val hval
   139	    rwa [abelDivAffTrans_app_coe, abelDivAffTrans_app_coe] at this
   140	  -- membership of the rank-one class of `sx`
   141	  have hmem : (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op Z) sx
   142	      ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op Z) := x.property
   143	  -- arbitrary-test uniqueness forces the vehicle sections to agree
   144	  have hsxy : sx = sy := divFamZarAff_eq_of_rankOne pi Z sx sy hmem habel
   145	  exact Subtype.ext (hinj (hsx ▸ hsy ▸ hsxy))
   146	
   147	/-- Componentwise injectivity of the restricted represented Abel map on the big site: the
   148	`Σ`-extension preserves the slicewise injectivity of `rankOneAbelRepresented`. -/
   149	theorem rankOneAbelSigma_app_injective (Y : Schemeᵒᵖ) :
   150	    Function.Injective ((rankOneAbelSigma pi).app Y) := by
   151	  rintro ⟨a, ξ⟩ ⟨b, η⟩ h
   152	  have ha : (⟨a, (rankOneAbelRepresented pi).app (op (Over.mk a)) ξ⟩ :
   153	        Σ c : Y.unop ⟶ Spec (.of k),
   154	          (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor.obj (op (Over.mk c)))
   155	      = ⟨b, (rankOneAbelRepresented pi).app (op (Over.mk b)) η⟩ := h
   156	  obtain ⟨rfl, h2⟩ := Sigma.mk.inj_iff.mp ha
   157	  simp only [heq_eq_eq] at h2
   158	  obtain rfl := rankOneAbelRepresented_app_injective pi (Over.mk a) h2
   159	  rfl

   163	namespace PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData
   164	
   165	/-- **The Abel inverse law holds automatically**: every canonical evaluation-divisor classifier
   166	of the rank-one locus is a two-sided inverse of the restricted Abel map.  From the right inverse
   167	`E.divisor_abel` and injectivity of `rankOneAbelSigma pi`, the left inverse follows by
   168	cancellation. -/
   169	theorem abelInverse_of_uniqueness (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi) :
   170	    E.AbelInverse := by
   171	  have h : rankOneAbelSigma pi ≫ E.divisor
   172	      = 𝟙 (rankOneDivisorLocus (C := C) (pi := pi)) := by
   173	    ext Y d
   174	    change E.divisor.app Y ((rankOneAbelSigma pi).app Y d) = d
   175	    apply rankOneAbelSigma_app_injective pi Y
   176	    exact E.divisor_abel_app pi Y.unop ((rankOneAbelSigma pi).app Y d)
   177	  exact h
   178	
   179	/-- The rank-one family isomorphism, with the Abel inverse discharged: the restricted Abel map
   180	and the canonical evaluation divisor are mutually inverse on the big site. -/
   181	noncomputable def rankOneAbelIso (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi) :
   182	    rankOneDivisorLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) ≅ rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) :=
   183	  E.evaluationIso pi (E.abelInverse_of_uniqueness pi)
   184

     9	/-!
    10	# The universal divisor rank-one open contract
    11	
    12	The genus divisor representer is unconditional, while the rank-one restriction still needs a
    13	family-level open-locus producer.  This file separates those two facts.  The predicate below is
    14	the inverse image of `PicRankOneOpen` along the represented universal Abel map.  A
    15	`DivRankOneOpenData` witness identifies that predicate with the range of one actual open of the
    16	representer; only after that witness is supplied do we define the open subscheme.
    17	
    18	This shape prevents a logical `Subfunctor` from being silently reinterpreted as a scheme.  It also
    19	gives the canonical inverse lane a stable contract: it consumes the witness equality and can use
    20	the resulting open inclusion and all of its pullbacks without choosing a generator.
    21	-/

    39	/-- The universal genus-divisor predicate whose Abel class lies in `PicRankOneOpen`. -/

    42	  divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi

    44	/-- Evaluation of the represented genus Abel map on a slice point, with the base morphism
    45	transported from the point in the divisor representer to its source. -/
    46	theorem abelDivAffGenusSigma_app_left_rankOne
    47	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    48	    (q : T ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C) :
    49	    (abelDivAffGenusSigma C).app (op T.left) q.left =
    50	      (⟨T.hom,
    51	        (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T)
    52	          ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q)⟩ :
    53	        (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
    54	          (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))).obj (op T.left)) := by
    55	  change (⟨q.left ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom, _⟩ :
    56	      (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
    57	        (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))).obj (op T.left)) =
    58	    ⟨T.hom,
    59	      (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T)
    60	        ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q)⟩
    61	  refine Over.sigmaExtension_ext
    62	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) q.w ?_
    63	  let e : Over.mk (q.left ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom) ⟶ T :=
    64	    Over.mkCongr q.w
    65	  let q' : Over.mk (q.left ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom) ⟶
    66	      divRepAffGenusScheme C :=
    67	    Over.homMk q.left rfl
    68	  have hq : e ≫ q = q' := by
    69	    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    70	    exact Category.id_comp _
    71	  change (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map e.op
    72	      ((abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T)
    73	        ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q)) =
    74	    (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app
    75	      (op (Over.mk (q.left ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom)))
    76	      ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q')
    77	  have hnat := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    78	    ((abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).naturality e.op)
    79	      ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q)
    80	  have hhom :
    81	      (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q' =
    82	        (divFunctorAff C (genus C)).map e.op
    83	          ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q) := by
    84	    calc
    85	      (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q' =
    86	          (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv (e ≫ q) := by
    87	            rw [hq]
    88	      _ = (divFunctorAff C (genus C)).map e.op
    89	          ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q) :=
    90	        (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv_comp e q
    91	  rw [hhom]
    92	  simpa only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] using hnat.symm

    94	/-- A represented genus divisor lies in the universal predicate exactly when its Abel image
    95	lifts through the single public rank-one Picard locus. -/
    96	theorem divRankOneUniversalPredicate_mem_iff_sigma
    97	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    98	    (x : (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)).obj T) :
    99	    x ∈ (divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi).obj T ↔
   100	      ∃ v : (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
   101	          (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor).obj (op T.unop.left),
   102	        (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op T.unop.left) v =
   103	          (abelDivAffGenusSigma C).app (op T.unop.left) x.left := by
   104	  simp only [divRankOneUniversalPredicate,
   105	    divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter,
   106	    Subfunctor.preimage_obj, Set.mem_preimage]
   107	  let p := (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app T
   108	    ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv x)
   109	  change p ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T ↔ _
   110	  have hleft :
   111	      (abelDivAffGenusSigma C).app (op T.unop.left) x.left =
   112	        (⟨T.unop.hom, p⟩ :
   113	          (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
   114	            (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))).obj
   115	              (op T.unop.left)) :=
   116	    abelDivAffGenusSigma_app_left_rankOne x
   117	  constructor
   118	  · intro hp
   119	    refine ⟨⟨T.unop.hom, ⟨p, hp⟩⟩, ?_⟩
   120	    rw [hleft]
   121	    rfl
   122	  · rintro ⟨v, hv⟩
   123	    rw [hleft] at hv
   124	    dsimp [picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl,
   125	      CategoryTheory.Over.sigmaExtensionNat] at hv
   126	    rcases v with ⟨a, y⟩
   127	    dsimp at hv
   128	    have hfirst : a = T.unop.hom :=
   129	      congrArg (fun z => z.1) hv
   130	    cases hfirst
   131	    have hinj := Sigma.mk.inj hv
   132	    have heq :
   133	        ConcreteCategory.hom
   134	            ((PicRankOneOpen pi).ι.app
   135	              (op (Over.mk T.unop.hom))) y = p :=
   136	      eq_of_heq hinj.2
   137	    change p ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T
   138	    rw [← heq]
   139	    exact y.property

   141	/-- The Yoneda map induced by the inclusion of an open of an object in the slice.  Naming this
   142	map is useful to consumers which need the actual factorisation through the open, rather than only
   143	the proposition that a point lies in its range. -/
   144	def openSubfunctorMap (D : Over (Spec (.of k))) (U : D.left.Opens) :
   145	    yoneda.obj (Over.mk (U.ι ≫ D.hom)) ⟶ yoneda.obj D :=
   146	  yoneda.map (Over.homMk (U := Over.mk (U.ι ≫ D.hom)) U.ι)
   147	
   148	/-- The subfunctor represented by an open `U` of an object `D` in the slice over `Spec k`.
   149	
   150	Its values are precisely morphisms which factor through the open immersion `U.ι`; using the
   151	Yoneda range keeps this definition independent of any chosen affine presentation of `U`. -/
   152	def openSubfunctor (D : Over (Spec (.of k))) (U : D.left.Opens) :
   153	    Subfunctor (yoneda.obj D) :=
   154	  Subfunctor.range (openSubfunctorMap D U)

   156	/-- Unpack range membership into the actual source point and its equality in the ambient Yoneda
   157	functor.  This is the pointwise factorisation API used by inverse constructions. -/
   158	theorem openSubfunctor_mem_iff
   159	    (D : Over (Spec (.of k))) (U : D.left.Opens)
   160	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   161	    (x : (yoneda.obj D).obj T) :
   162	    x ∈ (openSubfunctor D U).obj T ↔
   163	      ∃ y : (yoneda.obj (Over.mk (U.ι ≫ D.hom))).obj T,
   164	        (openSubfunctorMap D U).app T y = x := by
   165	  rfl

   167	/-- An explicit geometric certificate for the universal rank-one predicate.
   168	
   169	The equality is the missing family-level producer/gluing statement: it identifies the logical
   170	preimage with an actual open of the canonical genus representer.  No default or top-open witness
   171	is manufactured here. -/
   172	structure DivRankOneOpenData (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi] where
   173	  carrier : (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left.Opens
   174	  carrier_eq :
   175	    openSubfunctor (divRepAffGenusScheme C) carrier =
   176	      divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi
   177	
   178	/-- Genuine relative openness of the public Picard rank-one locus produces the universal
   179	divisor rank-one open.  The carrier is the open image of the represented pullback of the Abel
   180	map, and the proof below identifies its Yoneda range with the defining predicate. -/
   181	theorem divRankOneOpenData_of_picRankOneOpen_isOpen
   182	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi) :
   183	    Nonempty (DivRankOneOpenData pi) := by
   184	  obtain ⟨X, snd, fst, hpb⟩ := h.rep (abelDivAffGenusSigma C)
   185	  letI : IsOpenImmersion snd :=
   186	    h.property (abelDivAffGenusSigma C) fst snd hpb
   187	  let U := snd.opensRange
   188	  refine ⟨⟨U, ?_⟩⟩
   189	  ext T x
   190	  rw [openSubfunctor_mem_iff]
   191	  rw [divRankOneUniversalPredicate_mem_iff_sigma]
   192	  have hpbT := (IsPullback.iff_app.mp hpb) (op T.unop.left)
   193	  rw [Types.isPullback_iff] at hpbT
   194	  constructor
   195	  · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
   196	    have hxy : x.left = y.left ≫ U.ι := by
   197	      have hleft := congrArg Over.Hom.left hy
   198	      exact hleft.symm
   199	    have hrange : Set.range x.left.base ⊆ Set.range snd.base := by
   200	      rw [← Scheme.Hom.coe_opensRange snd]
   201	      rintro z ⟨t, rfl⟩
   202	      rw [hxy, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
   203	      change U.ι.base (y.left.base t) ∈ snd.opensRange
   204	      change U.ι.base (y.left.base t) ∈ U
   205	      exact (y.left.base t).property
   206	    let u : T.unop.left ⟶ X :=
   207	      IsOpenImmersion.lift snd x.left hrange
   208	    have hu : u ≫ snd = x.left :=
   209	      IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _
   210	    refine ⟨fst.app (op T.unop.left) u, ?_⟩
   211	    have hcomm := congrArg
   212	      (fun f => (ConcreteCategory.hom f) u) hpbT.1
   213	    change (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op T.unop.left)
   214	        (fst.app (op T.unop.left) u) =
   215	      (abelDivAffGenusSigma C).app (op T.unop.left) (u ≫ snd) at hcomm
   216	    simpa only [hu] using hcomm
   217	  · rintro ⟨v, hv⟩
   218	    obtain ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩ := hpbT.2.2 v x.left hv
   219	    change u ≫ snd = x.left at hu₂
   220	    have hrange : Set.range x.left.base ⊆ Set.range U.ι.base := by
   221	      rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
   222	      change Set.range x.left.base ⊆ snd.opensRange
   223	      rw [Scheme.Hom.coe_opensRange]
   224	      rintro z ⟨t, rfl⟩
   225	      refine ⟨u.base t, ?_⟩
   226	      have happ := congrArg (fun f => f.base t) hu₂
   227	      simpa only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] using happ
   228	    let V : Over (Spec (.of k)) :=
   229	      Over.mk (U.ι ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom)
   230	    let j : V ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C :=
   231	      Over.homMk (U := V) U.ι

import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivRankOneOpen
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOneNativePresentation

/-!
# Assembly from a rank-one divisor-fibre pullback

This file isolates the last presheaf step in the arbitrary-scheme rank-one fibre construction.
Its input ties an open `W` to the displayed family, supplies native presentations on every
affine pullback, and supplies the canonical evaluation-divisor classifier.  The geometric input
to the assembly theorem is the genuine pullback square of that evaluation divisor along Abel.
The universal property of this stronger square produces, rather than assumes, the factorisation
field of `PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented`.

The global construction of the canonical classifier and its represented pullbacks remains an
upstream obligation.  The endpoint here keeps that obligation in its geometric `IsPullback`
form and feeds the resulting arbitrary-scheme fibres immediately to
`picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_fibrePresented`.

Thus this module is a conditional assembly interface, not the missing global producer: no
declaration below constructs the evaluator, the open family, or its pullback theorem.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
  CartesianMonoidalCategory

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]

noncomputable section

abbrev rankOneAmbient : Schemeᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u :=
  Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))

abbrev rankOneLocus : Schemeᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u :=
  Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor

/-- The divisor families whose Abel class has a rank-one presentation, extended to the big site. -/
abbrev rankOneDivisorLocus : Schemeᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u :=
  Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).toFunctor

/-- The restricted represented Abel map on the big site. -/
def rankOneAbelSigma :
    rankOneDivisorLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) ⟶
      rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) :=
  Over.sigmaExtensionNat (rankOneAbelRepresented pi)

/-- The ambient class of a divisor already known to lie in the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
def rankOneDivisorToAmbient :
    rankOneDivisorLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C) :=
  rankOneAbelSigma pi ≫ picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi

/-! ## The explicit geometric input -/

/-- The single canonical evaluation-divisor classifier used by every represented fibre.

Keeping this datum outside `PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput` prevents the classifier from
varying with the test scheme or displayed family. -/
structure PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData where
  divisor : rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) ⟶
    rankOneDivisorLocus (C := C) (pi := pi)
  divisor_abel : divisor ≫ rankOneAbelSigma pi = 𝟙 _

namespace PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData

/-- Applying restricted Abel to the canonical evaluation divisor recovers its rank-one class. -/
lemma divisor_abel_app (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi)
    (S : Scheme.{u}) (v : (rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi)).obj (op S)) :
    (rankOneAbelSigma pi).app (op S) (E.divisor.app (op S) v) = v := by
  exact congrArg (fun q => q.app (op S) v) E.divisor_abel

/-- The canonical divisor has the original ambient Picard class. -/
lemma divisor_toAmbient (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi) :
    E.divisor ≫ rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi = picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi := by
  rw [rankOneDivisorToAmbient, ← Category.assoc, E.divisor_abel, Category.id_comp]

/-- The separate uniqueness obligation saying every divisor in the rank-one presentation
preimage is the canonical evaluation divisor of its Abel class. -/
def AbelInverse (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi) : Prop :=
  rankOneAbelSigma pi ≫ E.divisor = 𝟙 _

/-- Once divisor uniqueness is proved, restricted Abel and canonical evaluation form the
rank-one family isomorphism. -/
def evaluationIso (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi) (h : E.AbelInverse) :
    rankOneDivisorLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) ≅ rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) where
  hom := rankOneAbelSigma pi
  inv := E.divisor
  hom_inv_id := h
  inv_hom_id := E.divisor_abel

end PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData

/--
The explicit data needed to assemble one arbitrary-scheme rank-one fibre.

`restrictedValue` is the restriction of the displayed ambient family to `W`, and
`nativePresentation` quantifies over every affine pullback of that value.  The parameter `E` is
the common evaluation-divisor classifier on the rank-one locus, with its Abel compatibility
kept explicit.  Divisor representability is deliberately not a field of this structure: it is
supplied separately as a pullback square to the assembly theorem.

In particular, no field-fibre dimension witness, unrelated line bundle, or pre-existing
`PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented` is accepted by this contract.  Conversely, this structure is not
itself a producer: an inhabitant must still supply the arbitrary-affine native presentations.
-/
structure PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput
    (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi)
    {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C)) where
  W : X.Opens
  restrictedValue : rankOneAmbient (C := C).obj (op (W : Scheme.{u}))
  restrictedValue_eq :
    restrictedValue =
      (yoneda.map W.ι ≫ g).app (op (W : Scheme.{u})) (𝟙 (W : Scheme.{u}))
  /-- The tied native presentation on every affine pullback of the restricted family value. -/
  nativePresentation :
    ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
      (t : overSpec k A ⟶ Over.mk restrictedValue.1),
      Nonempty (PicRankOneNativePresentation pi
        ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op restrictedValue.2))

namespace PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput

variable {X : Scheme.{u}}
variable {g : yoneda.obj X ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C)}
variable {E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi}

/-- The public-locus element carried by the restricted family value over `W`. -/
noncomputable def locusValue (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
    (rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi)).obj (op (F.W : Scheme.{u})) :=
  ⟨F.restrictedValue.1, ⟨F.restrictedValue.2,
    mem_picRankOneOpen_of_nativePresentations pi
      (fun A _ _ t => F.nativePresentation A t)⟩⟩

/-- The map into the public locus is obtained from its universal element by Yoneda. -/
noncomputable def fst (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
    yoneda.obj (F.W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶ rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) :=
  yonedaEquiv.symm F.locusValue

/-- The canonical evaluation divisor of the restricted family value over `W`. -/
noncomputable def evaluationDivisor
    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
    yoneda.obj (F.W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶ rankOneDivisorLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) :=
  F.fst ≫ E.divisor

/-- The factorisation clause required by `PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented`, exposed as the target
of the represented evaluation-divisor argument below. -/
def FibreFactorizationClause
    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : Scheme.{u}) (v : (rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi)).obj (op S)) (w : S ⟶ X),
    (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op S) v =
      g.app (op S) w →
    ∃ u : S ⟶ (F.W : Scheme.{u}),
      F.fst.app (op S) u = v ∧ u ≫ F.W.ι = w

lemma fst_comp_incl (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
    F.fst ≫ picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi = yoneda.map F.W.ι ≫ g := by
  apply yonedaEquiv.injective
  rw [yonedaEquiv_comp, fst, Equiv.apply_symm_apply, yonedaEquiv_apply,
    ← F.restrictedValue_eq]
  dsimp [locusValue, picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl,
    CategoryTheory.Over.sigmaExtensionNat]
  rfl

/-- The family evaluation divisor has the displayed family as its Abel class. -/
lemma evaluationDivisor_abel
    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
    F.evaluationDivisor ≫ rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi =
      yoneda.map F.W.ι ≫ g := by
  rw [evaluationDivisor, Category.assoc, E.divisor_toAmbient]
  exact F.fst_comp_incl

/-! ## The represented rank-one-divisor fibre square -/

/-- The open `W` represents the pullback of the restricted divisor-class map along the displayed
family, with its top map fixed by the canonical evaluation divisor.  This is stronger than the
factorisation clause for the public rank-one locus: it is a categorical pullback against the
entire restricted rank-one divisor presheaf. -/
def EvaluationDivisorPullback
    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) : Prop :=
  IsPullback
    F.evaluationDivisor
    (yoneda.map F.W.ι)
    (rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi)
    g

/-- The represented evaluation-divisor square produces the public-locus factorisation on every
test scheme. -/
lemma fibreFactorizationClause_of_evaluationDivisorPullback
    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
    (hpb : F.EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
    F.FibreFactorizationClause := by
  intro S v w hvw
  have hS := (IsPullback.iff_app.mp hpb) (op S)
  rw [Types.isPullback_iff] at hS
  have hcompat :
      (rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi).app (op S)
          (E.divisor.app (op S) v) =
        g.app (op S) w := by
    have h := congrArg
      (fun q => q.app (op S) v) E.divisor_toAmbient
    change
      (rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi).app (op S)
          (E.divisor.app (op S) v) =
        (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op S) v at h
    rw [h]
    exact hvw
  obtain ⟨u, huDivisor, huW⟩ :=
    hS.2.2 (E.divisor.app (op S) v) w hcompat
  change E.divisor.app (op S) (F.fst.app (op S) u) =
    E.divisor.app (op S) v at huDivisor
  change u ≫ F.W.ι = w at huW
  refine ⟨u, ?_, huW⟩
  calc
    F.fst.app (op S) u =
        (rankOneAbelSigma pi).app (op S)
          (E.divisor.app (op S) (F.fst.app (op S) u)) :=
      (E.divisor_abel_app pi S (F.fst.app (op S) u)).symm
    _ = (rankOneAbelSigma pi).app (op S) (E.divisor.app (op S) v) :=
      congrArg _ huDivisor
    _ = v := E.divisor_abel_app pi S v

/-! ## Assembly of the stronger fibre datum -/

/-- Assemble the public fibre presentation from the represented canonical evaluation-divisor
square.  Its `exists_factor` field is derived from the pullback universal property. -/
noncomputable def toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback
    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
    (hpb : F.EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
    PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented pi g where
  W := F.W
  fst := F.fst
  sq := F.fst_comp_incl
  exists_factor := by
    simpa only [FibreFactorizationClause] using
      F.fibreFactorizationClause_of_evaluationDivisorPullback pi hpb

@[simp]
lemma toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback_W
    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
    (hpb : F.EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
    (F.toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback pi hpb).W = F.W :=
  rfl

lemma toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback_isPullback
    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
    (hpb : F.EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
    IsPullback F.fst (yoneda.map F.W.ι) (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi) g :=
  (F.toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback pi hpb).isPullback

/-! ## Immediate openness consumer -/

theorem picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_evaluationDivisorPullbackFamilies
    (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi)
    (D : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
      (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C)),
      PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
    (hpb : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
      (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C)),
      (D X g).EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
    PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi := by
  apply picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_fibrePresented pi
  intro X g
  exact (D X g).toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback pi (hpb X g)

end PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput

end
end AlgebraicGeometry

/-!
# Narrow root for the AJCR-first Picard strategy

This root deliberately imports only the current route modules and contracts. Every later
contract endpoint must be checked here before it receives critical-path credit.

The tied local rank-one presentation, its canonical evaluation map, datum-side local-away
divisor equations, and the pullback-stable presentation locus are present. The conditional
`DivRankOneOpenData` representer and its open-immersion/base-change consumers are rooted. The
native evaluation section and the tied datum section have the same restriction-vanishing
predicate on every open, without a Noetherian hypothesis; their piece coordinates and principal
piece ideals agree, and those native-coordinate ideals commute with arbitrary affine
coefficient extension.

The native rank-one route now closes from certificates to public membership on the field fibre.
`RankOneFamilyCertificates.ofActualDatum` produces all four family certificates from a single
per-residue-field H1 witness plus a fibre class-degree law, with rank one computed
Noetherian-freely by `rankAtStalk_hModule_zero_eq_one_of_actualPairH1`. Arbitrary-cartesian
native base change is internalized by `isIso_canonicalBaseChangeMap_nativeModule`, so
`ofCertificatesWithNativeBaseChange` and `ofLocalPresentation` build native presentations with
no extra base-change certificate. Consequently `mem_picRankOneOpen_of_isSplitWitness` places
every split genus-degree field class in `PicRankOneOpen`, and the Pic0 separably closed
translated-cover feeder lands its translated layer element in the public locus:
`exists_sepClosedTranslated_mem_picRankOneOpen` is the phase-5 membership endpoint.

On the divisor side, the tied local presentation's finite principal-open evaluation divisors
glue: `exists_glued_rankOne_away_divisor_with_abel_evaluation` produces a `DivFamZarAff` over
the Noetherian etale carrier with the global Abel and relative-Picard identities, resting on
`baseOpenRankOneDivisor_awayMul_compat`. The big-site consumer scaffold reduces
`PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen` to one canonical evaluation-divisor classifier and per-test pullback
squares: `picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_evaluationDivisorPullbackFamilies`.

The glued divisor now descends: `existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_localPresentation` consumes
the finite-glue output and returns the unique Abel-correct `DivFamZarAff` over the original
affine base, conditional only on the named `RankOneDivisorUniqueness` interface (the
tensor-square cocycle is manufactured from uniqueness, the descended class is pinned by étale
separatedness); `canonicalRankOneDivisorOfPresentation` names that divisor. Toward discharging
the uniqueness interface, `exists_notMem_cechPicMap_eq_of_relPicMk_eq` localizes
`relPicMk`-equality to on-the-nose `picClass` equality near every prime (base Picard classes
die Zariski-locally). The public locus is fibrewise split:
`mem_picRankOneOpen_iff_isSplitWitness` at field bases, and
`isSplitWitness_testPoint_of_mem` at every point of an arbitrary test.

Fibre nonvanishing toward that discharge is landed:
`sectionsMapTop_ne_zero_of_divEq_certified` and its tensor-form consumer say a datum section
cutting a certified divisor is nonzero on every residue-field fibre — the exact input shape of
the rank-one unit-extraction engine.

Datum-section extraction is landed, Noetherian-free:
`exists_gluedSection_sectionLocalEquations_divEq` cuts any `LocalEquations` divisor whose
Picard class matches the datum's Čech class from a germ-regular global section of the glued
sheaf, up to `DivEq` on every subordinated pointed cover — the α-corrected gluing through the
glued sheaf's own sheaf property; and `sectionLocalEquations_smul_divEq` records that global
unit rescalings of the section do not move the cut divisor.

The uniqueness interface is now DISCHARGED: `divFamZarAff_eq_of_picClass_eq_cechPicClass`
proves at most one certified divisor family per rank-one datum class (extraction + fibre
nonvanishing + the unit-extraction engine), and `rankOneDivisorUniqueness` assembles it with
the base-discrepancy localization, away-span separatedness, and faithfully-flat descent into
an unconditional proof of `RankOneDivisorUniqueness`. The canonical rank-one divisor and its
Abel/uniqueness accessors are re-exported without the interface hypothesis
(`canonicalRankOneDivisor`).

The Abel inverse law is also discharged: `divFamZarAff_eq_of_rankOne` upgrades the affine
uniqueness to arbitrary tests through the vehicle's affine-open separatedness, so the
restricted Abel map is componentwise injective on the big site
(`rankOneAbelSigma_app_injective`) and every evaluation-divisor classifier is automatically a
two-sided inverse (`abelInverse_of_uniqueness`); `rankOneAbelIso` packages the isomorphism,
gated only on an inhabitant of `PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData`.

Still missing, and NOT replaced here by axioms or local hypotheses: existence of Abel-correct
witnesses over non-Noetherian affine bases (the presentation carrier must currently be
Noetherian), an inhabitant of `PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData` (the canonical global divisor
/ Abel section), `PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen` itself, and the later
representability/descent/`JacobianData` endpoints.
-/

Finite-Galois descent lacks the Pic^0 invariant-match theorem

No honest producer of `pic0_representableBy` exists in either AJCR project. The rebuild has quotient/cocycle substrate, but no natural equivalence identifying base `pic0TypeFunctor` classes with Galois-invariant extension classes; consequently no `representableBy_of_finiteGalois_baseChange` can yet construct the base representation. The sibling theorem targets a different full Picard functor and is sorry-backed. Prove this invariant-match interface before crediting roadmap Phase 7 or the Jacobian headline.

/-

import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivRepAffChallenge
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0AtlasFromDivRepAff
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0ChartAtlasCoupling

/-!
# The widened divisor representer at the Picard atlas seam

The widened divisor functor of a challenge curve is represented at the genus parameter.  This
module inserts that representation into the Abel construction and then into the Zariski-local
representability theorem for the degree-zero Picard functor.

The resulting chart family has no assumed divisor representation.  Its remaining inputs are the
two geometric conditions of the local-representability theorem: every restricted Abel map is a
representable open immersion, and the restricted maps cover the Picard sheaf pointwise.

This is not an unconditional Picard representability result: the final declaration below retains
both geometric inputs.  Moreover, at the larger admissible coverage parameter the raw Abel map has
positive-dimensional linear-system fibres in positive genus, so the larger divisor representer
cannot simply be substituted as an open chart source.  The remaining datum-tail construction is
the corrected Altman--Kleiman step: represent the quotient by equality of the induced Picard class,
thereby removing those fibres before applying the Picard representability seam.

## Main declarations

* `AlgebraicGeometry.abelSigmaChartAffGenus` is the widened Abel chart formed from the chosen
  genus-parameter divisor representer.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.universalDivFamAffGenus` is its universal widened divisor family.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.abelSigmaChartAffAdmissible` is the no-argument widened Abel map at the
  unconditional admissible coverage parameter; its legal chart index is chosen internally.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.universalDivFamAffAdmissible` is the corresponding universal family.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.affineGenusChart` restricts a multi-index family of these maps to chosen
  source opens.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.pic0RepresentableByOfAffineGenusCharts` is the conditional final assembly
  once the restricted charts are open immersions and cover pointwise.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory Opposite

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

noncomputable section

/-- The universal widened divisor family carried by the chosen genus-parameter representer. -/
def universalDivFamAffGenus :
    divFamZarAff C (genus C) (divRepAffGenusScheme C) :=
  (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv (𝟙 _)

/-- Pulling back the chosen universal family gives the widened family classified by the
corresponding morphism into the genus representer. -/
theorem universalDivFamAffGenus_map {T : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    (q : T ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C) :
    divFamZarAff.map C (genus C) q (universalDivFamAffGenus C)
      = (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q := by
  have h := (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv_comp q
    (𝟙 (divRepAffGenusScheme C))
  rw [Category.comp_id] at h
  exact h.symm

/-- The universal widened divisor family carried by the unconditional representer at the
admissible coverage parameter. -/
def universalDivFamAffAdmissible :
    divFamZarAff C (divRepAffAdmissibleParameter C) (divRepAffAdmissibleScheme C) :=
  (divFunctorAff_admissible_representableBy C).homEquiv (𝟙 _)

/-- Pullback of the admissible universal family agrees with classification by the unconditional
admissible representer. -/
theorem universalDivFamAffAdmissible_map {T : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    (q : T ⟶ divRepAffAdmissibleScheme C) :
    divFamZarAff.map C (divRepAffAdmissibleParameter C) q
        (universalDivFamAffAdmissible C)
      = (divFunctorAff_admissible_representableBy C).homEquiv q := by
  have h := (divFunctorAff_admissible_representableBy C).homEquiv_comp q
    (𝟙 (divRepAffAdmissibleScheme C))
  rw [Category.comp_id] at h
  exact h.symm

/-- The widened Abel chart at the genus parameter, using the challenge curve's chosen divisor
representer rather than accepting a representability witness as an argument. -/
def abelSigmaChartAffGenus
    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (genus C : ℤ)) :
    yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1 :=
  abelSigmaChartAff C (genus C) (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C) m Z hdeg

attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra in
attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver in
/-- The widened Abel map at the unconditional admissible coverage parameter.  A legal chart
index whose locus is universal is chosen internally; this declaration does not assert that the
raw Abel map is an open immersion or an atlas. -/
def abelSigmaChartAffAdmissible :
    yoneda.obj (divRepAffAdmissibleScheme C).left ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1 := by
  classical
  letI : C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := .ofHom C.hom
  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
  haveI : IsIntegral C.left := isIntegral_left_of_geometricallyReduced C
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType C.hom)
  haveI : QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (QuasiCompact C.hom)
  haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0) :=
    moduleFinite_hModule_zero C
  haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1) :=
    moduleFinite_hModule_one C
  let hchart := exists_uniform_admissibleCoverageChart_eq_univ
    (C := C) (divRepAffP1Map_comp C) (genus C) (chi_moduleKSheaf C)
  let m : ℕ := Classical.choose hchart
  let hZ := Classical.choose_spec hchart
  let Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor := Classical.choose hZ
  have hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C)
        - (divRepAffAdmissibleParameter C : ℤ) := by
    change Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C)
        - (admissibleCoverageParameter
            (C := C) (divRepAffP1Map_comp C) (genus C) : ℤ)
    exact (Classical.choose_spec hZ).1
  exact abelSigmaChartAff C (divRepAffAdmissibleParameter C)
    (divFunctorAff_admissible_representableBy C) m Z hdeg

/-- The structure morphism read from a genus-parameter widened Abel chart is the structure
morphism of the chosen divisor representer. -/
lemma chartHom_abelSigmaChartAffGenus
    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (genus C : ℤ))
    {ι : Type u} (i : ι) :
    chartHom C (fun _ : ι => abelSigmaChartAffGenus C m Z hdeg) i
      = (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom :=
  chartHom_abelSigmaChartAff (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C) m Z hdeg i

/-- The structure morphism read from the admissible Abel map is the structure morphism of the
unconditional admissible divisor representer. -/
lemma chartHom_abelSigmaChartAffAdmissible {ι : Type u} (i : ι) :
    chartHom C (fun _ : ι => abelSigmaChartAffAdmissible C) i
      = (divRepAffAdmissibleScheme C).hom := by
  dsimp only [abelSigmaChartAffAdmissible]
  exact chartHom_abelSigmaChartAff
    (divFunctorAff_admissible_representableBy C) _ _ _ i

/-- A multi-index family of genus-parameter widened Abel charts, restricted to source opens.
Different indices may use different twists and different opens, but they all use the same
unconditional divisor representer. -/
def affineGenusChart {ι : Type u}
    (m : ι → ℕ) (Z : ι → (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
    (hdeg : ∀ i, Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k (Z i)
      = (m i : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (genus C : ℤ))
    (V : ∀ _ : ι, (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left.Opens) (i : ι) :
    yoneda.obj (V i : Scheme) ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1 :=
  restrictChart (abelSigmaChartAffGenus C (m i) (Z i) (hdeg i)) (V i)

/-- The structure morphism of a restricted genus chart is the inclusion of its source open
followed by the structure morphism of the chosen divisor representer. -/
lemma chartHom_affineGenusChart {ι : Type u}
    (m : ι → ℕ) (Z : ι → (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
    (hdeg : ∀ i, Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k (Z i)
      = (m i : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (genus C : ℤ))
    (V : ∀ _ : ι, (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left.Opens) (i : ι) :
    chartHom C (affineGenusChart C m Z hdeg V) i
      = (V i).ι ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom := by
  have hrestrict := chartHom_restrictChart (C := C)
    (abelSigmaChartAffGenus C (m i) (Z i) (hdeg i)) (V i) i
  have hgenus := chartHom_abelSigmaChartAffGenus C (m i) (Z i) (hdeg i) i
  simpa only [chartHom, affineGenusChart] using
    hrestrict.trans (congrArg ((V i).ι ≫ ·) hgenus)

/-- The degree-zero Picard functor is represented by the glued object of any pointwise-covering
family of open genus-parameter widened Abel charts.

The divisor representation is construction data, not a hypothesis: it is supplied by
`divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy`.  The two hypotheses are exactly the geometric inputs of
Zariski local representability. -/
def pic0RepresentableByOfAffineGenusCharts {ι : Type u}
    (m : ι → ℕ) (Z : ι → (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
    (hdeg : ∀ i, Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k (Z i)
      = (m i : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (genus C : ℤ))
    (V : ∀ _ : ι, (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left.Opens)
    (hf : ∀ i, IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (affineGenusChart C m Z hdeg V i))
    (hcov : PointwiseCoverage C (affineGenusChart C m Z hdeg V)) :
    Σ J : Over (Spec (.of k)), (pic0TypeFunctor C).RepresentableBy J := by
  letI : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.zariskiTopology
      (Sigma.desc (affineGenusChart C m Z hdeg V)) :=
    isLocallySurjective_sigmaDesc_of_pointwise C _ hcov
  exact ⟨_, pic0RepresentableByOfCharts C (affineGenusChart C m Z hdeg V) hf⟩

end

end AlgebraicGeometry
